next_step: Run 2-week A/B canary with evals harness; confirm SLA SLOs for 95p latency
notes:
Account summary: enterprise customer building RAG for internal knowledge base + external support portal. Currently ~25M passages (~200GB vector store), daily ingest window, growing 2-3M passages/month. Today using Pinecone + custom BERT reranker for post-filtering; considering full migration to Redwood Dedicated + Optimize for cost and predictable latency.

Technical constraints and targets:
- End-to-end rerank + semantic retrieval p95 latency target: <=200-250ms (user-facing). Current p95 measured ~720ms on peak.
- Cost sensitivity: target combined cost per query (approx embedding lookup + reranker compute) <= $0.005. Finance requires clear unit economics.
- Index scale: 25M passages, expect 50M within 6 months. Need indexing procedures, incremental reindex, snapshot/rollback.
- Quality bar: cannot accept >1.5% drop in precision@1 on baseline eval set. Legal/PM: "can't accept any degradations in answer correctness even if latency/price improves" (quote from Head of Search).

Security & compliance:
- EU data residency + GDPR controls mandatory.
- SSO via Okta (SAML) + SSO provisioning for engineers.
- KMS integration required for model keys and vector encryption at rest.
- Audit logging + 7-year retention on access logs requested by legal.

Migration approach discussed:
- Evals-first strategy: run offline batch evals on candidate embedder + reranker combo (5k high-value queries, labeled). Define automatic rollback thresholds.
- Live canary: start with 10% traffic to Redwood Dedicated (GPU pool) for 2 weeks; shadow mode for hybrid comparisons. Collect both online metrics (latency, error rates) and evaluation deltas.
- A/B: evaluate quality regressions via A/B on 10k query sample over 14 days, measure precision@1, MRR, and user satisfaction proxy (click-through).

POC findings (Feb demo & infra lab):
- Redwood's candidate embedding quantized model gave ~1.8x cost savings in bench runs, but initial reranker variant showed 1.2% drop in precision@1 on their curated eval set. Team flagged as blocker.
- Batching + KV cache in Redwood runtime reduced per-token latency by ~30% in synthetic load tests.
- Integration notes: need to map current metadata fields (product_id, doc_version, legal_tags) into Redwood ingestion schema.

Stakeholders: CTO (migration sponsor), Head of Search (quality owner), Legal (data residency and retention), Infra Lead (owns on-prem connector).

Quotes / meeting snippets:
- "If we can't match our current accuracy we won't switch — quality first." — Head of Search (2026-02-18).
- "Show us the rollback automation and the eval gating — we want a single-button rollback if A/B fails." — CTO (2026-03-02).

Quick wins we've proposed:
- Run Redwood Optimize to get batching/quant suggestions and cost projections for current workload.
- Offline eval run (5k queries) to triage embedding choices pre-canary.
- Canary schema and playbook: traffic split, automatic eval runs, rollback trigger thresholds.

Open questions for Redwood sales/SE:
- Exact SLA for dedicated pool at 95p under 50M index footprint?
- Can we pin a reranker variant and fallback to CPU-hosted model on failure?
- How are incremental reindexes handled without impacting live traffic?

Attachments and references: Drive deck (pricing + infra), Fireflies recordings (demo & security call), sample eval set (private).
